caseNameFull: Dillon v. United States and Crowley v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Edward L. O’Connor for petitioners. Solicitor General Biddle, Assistant Attorney General Rogge, and Messrs. William W. Barron, J. Albert Woll, M. Joseph Matan, and W. Marvin Smith for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.

Reported below: 113 F. 2d 334.
